_README: Accepted findings for tools/gate-wiring.mjs. An entry here is a DECISION, not a snooze: every one needs a reason below. Anything without a written justification does not belong in this file — the gate is allowed to stay red while real defects are open.

_methods_reasons.debugPose: weapons debug-only; driven from src/weapons/preview.js harness, not gameplay
_methods_reasons.debugStage: ai capture-only; staged tableau for screenshots, invoked from the shot harness
_methods_reasons.setFromObject: physics helper used by the weapons preview harness only
_methods_reasons.patchMaterials: render internal, invoked through the material system during init
_methods_reasons.requestEnvMap: render internal, driven by the sky subsystem probe cycle

_events_reasons.ui:pause: SUPPLEMENTARY, verified not a defect. The gate flagged this and I wrongly concluded the game never pauses (menu.js:183 even says 'while the game is frozen', and grepping engine.js for 'time.scale' found nothing). Reading the code refuted it: menu.open() sets t.scale=0 and calls player.setControlEnabled(false); engine.js:125 computes t.dt = rawDt * t.scale, so update/lateUpdate receive dt=0 AND engine.js:130 _accum += t.dt keeps the fixed-step loop from running at all. Physics and AI both freeze. My grep missed it because the code aliases this.time to `t`. The event is a notification for anyone who wants it.
_events_reasons.ui:quality: SUPPLEMENTARY. menu.js:136 calls ctx.config.setQuality(name) DIRECTLY, then emits. The setting applies without any listener.
_events_reasons.ui:sensitivity: SUPPLEMENTARY. menu.js:42 assigns ctx.config.sensitivity directly, then emits.
_events_reasons.ui:fov: SUPPLEMENTARY. menu.js:48 assigns ctx.config.fov and updates the camera directly, then emits.
_events_reasons.ui:setting: SUPPLEMENTARY. Generic settings-changed notification; every individual setting is already applied at its own call site.
_events_reasons._still_open: player:health, player:heartbeat, sky:changed, sky:env and the ai:bark dead subscription are NOT allow-listed - they have not been adjudicated yet and stay red until they are.
